answer: The strongest defense is vested payouts: agent earnings flow into a vesting river that releases in slices across many epochs, and identity scores tie to that flow. Attackers mint raven-like pseudonyms cheaply, but each account earns only small slices that drip slowly; rotating identities forfeits most locked earnings back to the pool. To profit, every fake identity must survive the full vesting horizon doing useful work, so the forge of fake agents costs more than honest income. Sybil resistance becomes an economic time lock, not a filter.
